name: Danielle Gervasoni
title: Sexual Health Psychologist
description: Dani has experience and a special interest in supporting clients with desire and arousal dissatisfaction. She is also interested in working with a wide range of sexual health and intimacy concerns. An LGBTIQA+ ally.
specialties: Sexuality, Desire and arousal, Sexual health, Intimacy, LGBTIQA+

name: Emma Blanchard
title: Sexual Health Psychologist
description: Emma is passionate about supporting clients from LGBTQIA+, rainbow family, and non-monogamous communities. Areas include sexual trauma and intimate partner violence; approaches include schema therapy.
specialties: LGBTQIA+, Rainbow families, Non-monogamy, Sexual trauma, Schema therapy, Neurodivergence, Anxiety

name: Rebecca Apokis
title: Sexual Health Psychologist
description: ACT and CBT within a trauma-informed, attachment-focused framework. Areas include sexual pain, libido differences, LGBTIQA+ support, kink-specific support, poly/non-monogamy support, sex work support, and adult sexual trauma.
specialties: Sexuality, Kink, LGBTIQA+, Polyamory, Sex work, Sexual trauma, Neurodivergence

name: Sarah-Jane Leander
title: Sexual Health Psychologist
description: Sarah has experience in working with clients through a wide range of sexual health and intimacy concerns. Treatment areas include sexual pain, desire and arousal concerns, relationship difficulties, LGBTQIA+ support.
specialties: Sexual health, Sexual pain, Desire and arousal, LGBTQIA+, ACT, CBT, DBT

name: Melissa Luttringer
title: Sexual Health Clinician (Counsellor) and Relationship Therapist
description: Melissa is sex-positive, sex work-friendly, and experienced in working with BDSM, kink, and fetishes. As a strong LGBTQIA+ ally, she believes everyone deserves to explore and express their sexuality safely.
specialties: BDSM, Kink, Sexuality, Sex work, LGBTQIA+, Gender questioning, Trauma processing, Relationship therapy

name: Lauren French
title: Sexual Health Clinician (Sexologist)
description: Lauren loves supporting anyone who missed out on quality, shame-free and sex-positive education growing up. She believes everyone deserves respectful relationships and knowledge around their own body and desires.
identity: Proud Karajarri woman; bisexual woman of colour

name: Thanh Nguyen
title: Sexual Health Clinician (Social Worker)
description: Thanh has a particular interest in supporting clients navigating sexual trauma (both recent and historical). Thanh's areas of special interest also include sexual pain, particularly vaginismus.
specialties: Sexual trauma, Sexual pain, Vaginismus, Sexual health
